name: three_a
intro: A three-stage lock. Clear all three modules to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - WIRES
Cut exactly one wire:
- If there is exactly one green wire, cut the GREEN wire.
- If there are two or more red wires, cut the FIRST wire.
- Otherwise, cut the LAST wire.

MODULE 2 - BUTTON
- If the button is YELLOW, HOLD it.
- Otherwise, PRESS it.

MODULE 3 - KEYPAD
One symbol glows. Enter its code:
- circle: 4040
- square: 5050
- triangle: 6060

modules.title: A bundle of wires
modules.observation: Four wires, left to right: red, blue, green, yellow.

modules.title: A symbol keypad
modules.observation: A keypad with a glowing SQUARE symbol above it.
